blocks.text: Zscaler provides different types of communications to ensure that you are always well informed. You can view or receive notifications on new data centers or scheduled maintenance windows, product updates, security advisories, and other operational activities, as well as view up-to-date cloud status through the following portals:

blocks.item: Zscaler Trust Portal
You can go to the Zscaler Trust Portal at https://trust.zscaler.com to view insights into cloud operation status, upcoming maintenance, and security updates.

The information on this site is continually updated and maintained through the combined efforts of the Zscaler Operations, Engineering, and Security teams. The site provides a histogram that shows cloud platform issues, and indicators and explanations to help you better understand incidents. You also have access to 90 days of historical data. The subscription service gives you granular control over which data centers and services you want to receive updates for and the ability to add a mailing list to receive the updates.
To have more granular control over what you see, go to https://trust.zscaler.com and create an account:
Click Sign In or Subscribe located on the top-right corner of the page.
Click Sign Up and fill out the fields.
Click Submit. You'll receive an email to verify your account.
To add a group email, after you create your account, do the following:
Log in to the Zscaler Trust Portal, select the drop-down icon next to your login email, and go to Settings.
See image.
Under the Group Settings section, enter your group email.
Your group receives the same subscriptions based on your subscriptions.
Click Save Changes.

You can subscribe to receive notifications on maintenance and cloud status. To control your subscriptions, sign in to your Zscaler Trust Portal account, select the drop-down icon next to your login email, and go to the Subscriptions page.
See image.
On the Subscriptions page:
Select the cloud you want to manage subscriptions for.
Subscribe All or Unsubscribe All for all notifications on the page.
Subscribe to Scheduled and Completed maintenance notifications.
Subscribe to In Progress and Resolved advisory notifications.
Subscribe to notifications for All core cloud services, or select which core cloud services you want to subscribe to.
Subscribe to All data centers, or select which data centers you want to subscribe to.
Zscaler Admin Console

In addition to the notifications and bulletins that are posted or subscribed to on the Zscaler Trust Portal, Zscaler also sends the following notifications to the Technical and Business contacts listed on the Organization page (Administration > Administration > Organization > Contacts) in the Zscaler Admin Console:
Security Updates: Latest information on vulnerabilities and threats that might affect your organization.
Service Updates: New service and product enhancements, including new data center notifications and cloud release information.
Product Updates: Communication regarding important changes and updates to our service.

Ensure that these contacts are always current. You can enter a group email address to send the notification to an entire team instead of an individual. Additionally, an admin can be subscribed to these updates when adding or editing an admin.

blocks.text: Zscaler's Service Continuity Policy governs how and when we make changes to our services. Our End-of-Sale (EOS) and End-of-Life (EOL) Policy is separate from our Service Continuity Policy. To learn more, see EOS and EOL Policy.
